question: For the fixed low-dimensional 4h ETH/SOL leadership estimator family inherited from 0048, can training readiness and shadow-calibration readiness be determined causally from estimator precision under serial dependence rather than by a fixed 365-day-equivalent observation count, while preserving post-2022 4h target outcomes against 0054 inspection?
hypothesis: A fixed 2190-origin calendar-equivalent burn-in is not the only defensible readiness rule for a 7-dimensional ridge dynamic component and one-parameter temperature scaler. A causal precision stopping rule using fixed-lag HAC uncertainty may establish estimator readiness earlier without consulting predictive performance or post-2022 target outcomes.
economic_mechanism: 0054 is statistical-methodology infrastructure for the Beta-selection research program. It tests whether the estimator is precise enough to be evaluated later; it does not test ETH/SOL leadership alpha, confidence concentration or portfolio economics.
stopping_rule: After this preregistration merges, implement exactly one 0054 methodology engine with the frozen 4h feature/target translation, target firewall, HAC estimator, probe sets and precision gates. Execute exactly one historical DEVELOPMENT methodology measurement. Any threshold, HAC, probe, firewall, feature/model or readiness-rule change after any 0054 numerical output is observed requires a new research ID. No predictive-performance metric may be computed or used for selection under 0054.
success_criteria: Training readiness is achieved using only labels whose complete 336-bar target path ends by 2022-12-31T20:00:00Z.
Calibration readiness is achieved using only matured shadow pairs whose complete 336-bar target path ends by 2022-12-31T20:00:00Z.
Post-2022 reserved target values are never read by the 0054 measurement path.
After frozen readiness activation, the label-blind reserved suffix contains at least 12 complete 336-ordered-eligible-row support blocks with full future maturity availability.
Canonical BRRK, Phase 6, signing, order submission and production authority remain unchanged.
failure_criteria: If the methodology prefix never achieves three consecutive frozen training-precision passes, classify FAIL_4H_NATIVE_TRAINING_PRECISION_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
If training readiness passes but the methodology prefix never achieves three consecutive frozen calibration-precision passes, classify FAIL_4H_NATIVE_CALIBRATION_PRECISION_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
If both readiness stages pass but the label-blind reserved suffix has fewer than 12 complete 336-row blocks, classify FAIL_4H_NATIVE_METHOD_READY_BUT_RESERVED_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT.

Any post-2022 ETH/SOL target inspection, forbidden predictive metric, numerical-integrity breach, hash mismatch or result-before-attempt persistence breach invalidates the execution rather than becoming a scientific result.
allowed_followup: Only PASS_4H_NATIVE_READINESS_METHOD_ELIGIBLE_FOR_NEW_PREDICTIVE_STUDY may authorize a separately preregistered post-2022 4h predictive-leadership research ID.
A later predictive study must freeze its own target/model/baselines/scoring/inference before reading reserved post-2022 ETH/SOL targets.
0054 PASS does not establish leadership predictability and does not authorize 0049 concentration.
forbidden_followup: No same-ID fixed burn-in sweep or substitution of 365, 672, 1344, 2190 or another count because observed support looks favorable.
No same-ID change to HAC Bartlett kernel, lag 335, numerical floor 672, probe sets, probability-width tolerances or three-consecutive-refit rule after output exposure.
No same-ID NLL, Brier, AUC, balanced accuracy, direction precision/recall, realized-margin correlation, confidence breakpoint or portfolio economics.
No post-2022 ETH/SOL target value may be read under 0054.
No 0048/0053 rerun or rescue and no direct 0049 concentration authority.
No canonical BRRK modification, Phase 6 modification, leverage expansion, signing, order submission or production authorization.
researcher_decisions: Design authority is research/governance/BRRK_LEADERSHIP_4H_NATIVE_READINESS_0054_DESIGN_FREEZE_2026-08-11.md merged at main SHA 34a20658d26dd5440aa48139a83a15757ecf394c.

Raw data are reused only from the immutable 0053 4h payload SHA256 471b54991ae648b79433285f073ea7bc813663319b6e2389c1682dad1a319135; no network fetch or replacement dataset is allowed.
Decision/refit clock is 168 4h bars. A target is training/calibration-eligible only after its full 336-bar future path has matured.

Methodology labels are permitted only when target path end <=2022-12-31T20:00:00Z. Origins from 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z onward are target-firewalled and may be used only for label-blind support accounting.
4h relative log price is z=log(SOL/ETH), d_t=z_t-z_t-1, and sigma1440 is sample standard deviation ddof=1 over the latest 1440 relative returns including t; epsilon=1e-12.
K1 uses d t-119..t length120; K2 t-359..t-120 length240; K3 t-719..t-360 length360; K4 t-1439..t-720 length720. Each K=tanh(sum(d)/((sigma1440+1e-12)*sqrt(length))).
Persistence360 is mean(sign(d)) over t-359..t with exact zero contributing zero. Position720 is 2*(z_t-min(z_t..z_t-719))/(max-min)-1 with exact zero range mapped to zero.
Participation uses quote_volume only: Activity_i=log((median120_i+1e-12)/(median720_i+1e-12)); Participation=tanh(Activity_SOL-Activity_ETH).

4h target horizons are h in {84,168,336}. A_i,h(t)=2/[h(h+1)]*sum_{u=1..h}log(P_i[t+u]/P_i[t]); L_i is equal one-third mean; M=L_SOL-L_ETH; Y=1 when M>0, 0 when M<0, exact M=0 is target tie excluded from model fitting.
BTC eligibility reuses the frozen 0053 4h calendar-equivalent FAST trend semantics with horizons 120/360/720/1440, weights 0.15/0.25/0.30/0.30 and condition BTC_FAST_4H>=0.

Candidate model is fixed: X=[K1,K2,K3,K4,Persistence360,Position720,Participation], Laplace matured-label prevalence pi=(N_SOL+1)/(N_SOL+N_ETH+2), raw probability=sigmoid(logit(pi)+beta_X), no fitted intercept, ridge lambda=1.

Training is expanding. The refit grid is anchored at the first common 4h timestamp with full 1440-bar feature history and advances exactly every 168 bars. Model/HAC evaluation is numerically inadmissible before 672 matured eligible methodology-prefix observations.

For ordered training score vectors g_i=X_i*(Y_i-p_i), center by their sample mean. Primary Bartlett HAC uses L=335 and sum-scale Omega=sum g_i g_iT + sum_{k=1..335}(1-k/336)*sum_{i=k+1..n}(g_i g_{i-k}T + g_{i-k} g_iT). H=X_T W X + I_7 and V_beta=H^{-1} Omega H^{-1}.

Canonical training probes are exactly {0} union {+/-0.5 e_j,+/-1.0 e_j, j=1..7}, 29 points. At q use centered dynamic probability sigmoid(beta_q), delta-method two-sided 95% width with z=1.959963984540054 and V_beta.
A training refit passes iff n>=672, all numerical calculations are valid, P90 of the 29 widths <=0.10 and max width <=0.20. Training readiness requires three consecutive passing 168-bar refits.
Shadow raw forecasts begin only after training readiness. They are emitted before outcomes exist and enter calibration only after 336-bar maturity, still subject to the 2022-12-31 target firewall.

Calibration preserves the prevalence prior: p_cal=sigmoid(logit(pi)+gamma*eta), eta=beta_X, gamma>=0 minimizing calibration-pool NLL under the same finite-stable-minimizer semantics as the frozen model family.

For centered scalar calibration scores u_i=eta_i*(Y_i-p_cal_i), Bartlett HAC uses the same L=335 sum-scale formula. H_gamma=sum eta_i^2*p_i*(1-p_i); Var(gamma)=Omega_gamma/H_gamma^2. Calibration is numerically inadmissible before 672 matured shadow pairs.

Calibration probes are exactly eta in {-2,-1,-0.5,-0.2,0.2,0.5,1,2}. Use centered mapping sigmoid(gamma*eta) and delta-method two-sided 95% widths. A calibration refit passes iff all calculations are valid and max width <=0.10; readiness requires three consecutive passing 168-bar refits.
A valid gamma=0 boundary optimum is not automatically a methodology failure if it is identified and the precision gate passes; 0054 tests estimability, not alpha.

Reserved suffix support begins at 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z or later if required by the frozen readiness activation. Count only feature-valid BTC-eligible origins with full 336-bar future availability by the frozen payload end. Blocks are sequential ordered eligible origins of length 336; require at least 12 complete blocks for PASS.
